name: Mamiya Marie
source:
She is the head of the Mamiya Zaibatsu and a bewitchingly beautiful widow.

She is also head of the Black Rose house, a separate house leaving the main house to her other daughters.

She has been living with her daughter Mariya at the Black Rose House for a while now.

[From [url=https://www.empress-game.com/title.html]official site[/url]]
